HT-BETA-CURRICULUM-CONTEXT.notes: Human reviewer reported that the first curriculum screen is decisively improved and reads much more like a professional curriculum surface. The same mobile review confirmed that portrait tables do not scroll horizontally, so not all columns can be inspected. The reviewer also identified a broader usability limit: entering the substance of the curriculum still behaves too much like sequential document reading and should evolve toward focused teacher exploration. No broader curriculum-context PASS is inferred from these partial observations.

supplementalKnowledgeExperience.notes: Human reviewer explicitly proposed a smart graph view as a complementary way to inspect curricular relations. This is recorded as product direction only; no graph relation or knowledge-experience PASS is inferred from the request.

findings.title: Le tabelle del Curricolo non scorrono orizzontalmente in portrait mobile
findings.evidence: Human reviewer reported on the published 37d89ff2 release that tables do not scroll when the phone is held vertically, preventing inspection of all columns.

findings.title: La consultazione web resta troppo sequenziale per entrare nel merito del curricolo
findings.evidence: Human reviewer judged the first screen decisively improved but identified the remaining limit as teacher usability: reaching annualities and curricular substance should not require document-like sequential reading. A focused exploration mode and a smart relational view were requested as the preferred direction.
